title: Supporting member for permanent appurtenances.
officialText:
Naturally durable or preservative-treated wood
shall be utilized for those portions of wood members that form the structural supports of buildings, balconies,
porches or similar permanent building appurtenances where such members are exposed to the weather without
adequate protection from a roof, eave, overhang or other covering to prevent moisture or water accumulation on the
surface or at joints between members.
